approval_scope.ui_appearance_feedback: User rejects the pictured UI as failing to inherit the previously specified style.

reuse.accepted_method: Generate semantic continuous-action B-roll, edit to narration, and hand the same object from generated footage into precisely controlled UI actions.
reuse.ui_rule: This sample's UI and the earlier fresh-use prototype are not approved visual baselines. Find the applicable existing confirmed sample and implementation before claiming style inheritance.

observed_failure.project_style_basis: Prior fresh-use sample: white, near-black, restrained lavender; no IP-specific character or voice.
observed_failure.diagnosis_by_assistant: The implementation substituted a palette summary and an unapproved prototype for a complete confirmed visual baseline; no approved segment, applicable profile, or visual implementation source was bound to the project.
observed_failure.exact_applicable_original_baseline: not yet identified for this unnamed-account sample; do not guess an account

evidence_boundary: The positive AIGC-integration feedback is not whole-film approval, UI-style approval, permission to replace an account baseline, or proof that every other conversation has refreshed its loaded instructions.
